item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena's school in Pune has a large banyan tree and a small pond in its garden. Her teacher asks: which statement best explains how this ecosystem benefits the people in the school?

options.A: It benefits people only because the school planted and maintains it for decoration.
options.B: Its living and non-living parts depend on each other, giving people fresh air, shade, and water that support life.
options.C: It benefits people only when the pond water is collected and sold for drinking.
options.D: It provides no benefit because humans do not eat anything growing in the garden.
